description: A Swift Charts surface. What it shows is one 'chart' description (columns, optional inline data, marks and chart modifiers) that a host replaces whole with setElementProperty; data rows are also set through the rows API.

chart.description: The chart description: 'columns', 'data', 'content' (ForEach; BarMark, LineMark, PointMark, RuleMark with their initializer arguments and mark modifiers), 'chartXScale'/'chartYScale' (domain, range, type), 'chartXAxis'/'chartYAxis', 'chartXAxisLabel'/'chartYAxisLabel', 'chartLegend', 'chartPlotStyle'. Its contents are checked by the Chart element when the document loads.

states.content.description: The chart's data rows as [[String]]; use getElementRows/setElementRows/appendElementRows
